blog_posts.quick_answer_geo: Offboarding remote employees requires an adapted process compared to in-office exits. The key differences are: equipment must be returned via a prepaid shipping kit, access revocation must be completed remotely through identity providers rather than physically, knowledge transfer must happen asynchronously using recorded walkthroughs and shared documents, and exit interviews are conducted via video call. The absence of in-person interaction makes a structured digital offboarding platform essential.

blog_posts.quick_answer_geo: An employee offboarding policy is a formal HR document that defines the standard process, responsibilities, timelines, and legal obligations that apply whenever an employee leaves the organisation — whether through resignation, termination, or redundancy.
